Rarity.maps_to: Potion.rarity = 'rare' (potions.py:1185), read by shop.MerchantPotionEntry pricing and by potion_pools.POTION_POOL's rarity bucket (potion_pools.py:38-65)
Rarity.rationale: EXECUTED, not asserted: `py audit/tools/potion_probes.py sweep-attrs` extracts PotionRarity from every C# model and diffs it against the sim class attribute over all 51 units and reports 0 mismatches. Rarity is observable in the sim (it sets the shop price and the reward-roll bucket), so this is a behavioural verdict rather than a field copy.

Usage.maps_to: no counterpart -- the sim has no out-of-combat potion use at all; CombatState.use_potion (combat.py:583) is the only entry point
Usage.issue: MECHANISM: PotionUsage.AnyTime means the game's Use button is live outside combat as well as in it, and PotionModel.OnUseWrapper is written for it -- `ICombatState combatState = Owner.Creature.CombatState` may legally be null and every later step null-checks it (PotionModel.cs:294, 298, 334, 336). The sim models no `usage` attribute and has exactly one use path, on CombatState: `py audit/tools/potion_probes.py sweep-usage` finds one `def use_potion` in sts2_rl/, and the conformance layer treats UsePotion as a combat-only command in both the driver and the runner (conformance/combat_driver.py:16, conformance/runner.py:147-150). So the whole out-of-combat arm of this potion is unreachable in the sim: there is no action for it in the env and no replay path for it in the runner. LIVE, and it is one of the four AnyTime potions (blood_potion, entropic_brew, foul_potion, fruit_juice) -- all four are ported, registered and reachable, so a recorded run that drinks one on the map, at a rest site or at a shop cannot be replayed; the UsePotion command falls to the _ROOM_BOUNDARY branch (conformance/runner.py:147-150) rather than being executed, so the belt and the HP the save asserts both drift. Filed as a gap, not a waiver: 'the sim has no path here' is today's content, not the shape of the divergence (binding rule 1).

TargetType.maps_to: no attribute -- `targeted` stays False, so CombatState.use_potion passes target=None (combat.py:608) and the potion applies to ctx.player (potions.py:1188-1190)
TargetType.rationale: TargetType.AnyPlayer in a single-player run always resolves to the owner: PotionModel.EnqueueManualUse defaults `target` to `Owner.Creature` when it is a valid target (PotionModel.cs:240-243) and IsValidTarget's Self/AnyPlayer arms accept exactly that creature (PotionModel.cs:280-287). The multiplayer half -- AnyPlayer letting you throw the potion at an ally, and CanThrowAtAlly (PotionModel.cs:381-388) gating it on `RunState.Players.Count > 1` -- is out of scope by the shared contract and noted in maps_to rather than verdicted as a divergence.

CanBeGeneratedInCombat.rationale: One of exactly three C# overrides (FairyInABottle.cs:19, FruitJuice.cs:20, RegenPotion.cs:22 -- executed grep), and the sim's set is exactly those three ids. Applied by generate_random_potion_in_combat (potion_pools.py:138-145) and NOT by generate_random_potion, matching PotionFactory.CreateRandomPotionInCombat vs ...OutOfCombat (PotionFactory.cs:31-34, 60-65).

OnUse (protected override, FruitJuice.cs.rationale: `CreatureCmd.GainMaxHp(target, MaxHp.BaseValue)` -> `CreatureCmd.gain_max_hp(hooks, player, 5)`, which raises max_hp and then heals the same amount (cmds.py:175-176) -- the SetMaxHp-then-Heal shape the sim's own docstring cites. The amount is an integer literal on both sides so the decimal truncation that blood_potion N1 settles cannot arise here.

guards.what: N1: this is the one potion whose effect PERSISTS past the combat, so the in-combat/out-of-combat split is not cosmetic
guards.rationale: Max HP is run state, and the sim keeps a separate run-side twin for it (RunState.gain_max_hp, named at cmds.py:172). The combat-side verb this potion uses writes PlayerCombatState.max_hp, and RunState.finish_combat is what carries it back to the run -- the same route every in-combat max-HP change takes, so nothing is specific to this potion. Recorded because it is the reachability half of this record's AnyTime gap: a Fruit Juice drunk on the map in a recorded run changes the max HP the conformance runner asserts at the next act boundary (conformance/runner.py's DETECTOR 3 player-HP assertion), so that gap is not merely theoretical.

guards.what: W: the shared PotionModel.OnUseWrapper pipeline every potion resolves through (audit/content/potion/shared-mechanisms.md)
guards.issue: MECHANISM, shared by all 51 units and recorded once per record because PotionModel is one of harness.py's MODEL_ROOT_CLASSES, so no unit record enumerates it -- and unlike CardModel/PowerModel/RelicModel it is NOT covered by any seam record either, which is the coverage hole audit/content/potion/shared-mechanisms.md exists to name. src/Core/Models/PotionModel.cs:291-342 in order: :293 RemoveBeforeUse (sim combat.py:603-606 nulls the slot and detaches the listener before the effect -- faithful); :297 Hook.BeforePotionUsed; :327 OnUse (this record's own hooks); :336 CombatManager.History.PotionUsed (no sim entry -- PotionUsedEntry.cs:9-38 adds only a Description string and an executed grep of src/ finds no game reader, so presentation only); :338 Hook.AfterPotionUsed (sim hooks.py:566-571 on_potion_used, dispatched at combat.py:610 -- faithful); :340 CheckForEmptyHand. TWO of those are LIVE gaps, and both are already owned by another record, so this entry MATCHES their verdicts per binding rule 3 rather than re-deriving them. (1) BeforePotionUsed has no sim dispatcher at all -- hooks.py declares only on_potion_used, whose own docstring says it mirrors AfterPotionUsed -- and its single C# implementer SurroundedPower.cs:82 is ported at powers.py:2523, so throwing a potion at the far Kaiser Crab arm does not turn the player to face it: audit/records/power/surrounded.json, gap, live. (2) CombatManager.cs:887-893 CheckForEmptyHand has exactly two callers, CardModel.cs:1992 and PotionModel.cs:340, and the sim's only on_hand_emptied call site is player.py:197 -- the end-of-turn flush CombatManager.cs:880-883 explicitly excludes: audit/records/relic/unceasing_top.json G1, gap, LIVE, executed with a potion witness. Reachable from EVERY potion, not only the hand-emptying ones, because C# tests the hand AFTER the use. Rollup `gap` per binding rule 4.

guards.what: W4: PotionModel.cs:324-331 brackets OnUse in BeginCardOrPotionEffect/EndCardOrPotionEffect and the sim has no re-entrancy depth counter
guards.issue: CombatManager.cs:889's `!IsExecutingCardOrPotionEffect(player)` is what stops a nested effect from triggering the empty-hand check early, and PotionModel.cs:324-331 is what puts a potion inside that bracket. The sim has no counterpart anywhere. DORMANT for the same reason audit/records/relic/unceasing_top.json G2 is dormant -- the ported cards that auto-play another card mid-resolution (cards/cascade.py:58, cards/colorless_skills.py:117) do not touch the draw pile between the inner and outer ends -- but recorded separately because the OUTER frame here is a potion, so a fix that brackets only card plays would leave this half open. What would make it live: any ported potion or card that empties the hand and then moves the draw pile from inside a nested auto-play.
